notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.14
notes.content:
[h1][b]ADDED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added translations: German, French, Spanish
[*]Added the ability to turn on the inversion of the view
[*]Added the ability to disable camera swinging left/right
[*]Added the ability to disable camera shaking
[*]Added subtitles to the intro
[/list]

[h1][b]IMPROVED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced use of the game's RAM
[*]Reduced the weight of the game from 7.42GB to 5.5GB
[*]Optimized player animations
[/list]

[h1][b]FIXED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the AI getting stuck in the floor
[*]Fixed the gate to the Warehouse location where it was possible to fall under the map
[*]Fixed a badly shaking camera at a time when the player often jumped and rested against the ceiling
[*]Fixed a place in Sector A where you could get stuck
[*]Fixed errors caused when interacting with buttons, keyboards, walkie-talkie
[*]Fixed the sequence of completing the task in Sector A about taking a flashlight and listening to a message from a walkie-talkie
[*]Fixed the HUD of the slot machine, which was shown when the player was in the car
[*]Fixed the ability to shoot in the car
[*]Fixed boxes whose decals could pass through objects
[*]Possible fix for game crashes
[/list]

[h1][b]MINOR CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Localization amendments
[*]Language change moved to settings
[/list]

notes.title: #Out of Oblivion 1.11
notes.content:
[h1][b]ADDED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*]Added input settings[/h3]
[h3][*]Added partial gamepad support[/h3]
[*]Added new hand models
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7UjLoJfRgjx86IAhZm/giphy.gif[/img]
[*]Added recoil to weapons
[*]Added a reload animation, in which the player, if not spent all the ammo, will reload the rifle without hitting the latch
[*]Added more widgets on levels
[*]Added a view from the camera to one of the monitors in the sewer.
[*]Added 1 first aid kit in the sewer, 1 first aid kit in sector B
[*]Added 2 wall maps in warehouse
[*]Added setting for the quality of "Effects"
[*]Added a new achievement "SWITCH"
[/list]

[h1][b]IMPROVED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*]Changed the system of damage from the bullets to opponents:[/h3]

Common demon and robots:
 * One bullet dies in the head
 * In the body from 3 bullets
 * At feet from 5 bullets
 * In the hands of 6 bullets

Big Demon:
 * Head from 4 bullets
 * In the body from 10 bullets
 * At feet from 15 bullets
 * In the hands of 20 bullets

 * If the hit is in the hand or foot, the enemy will not take damage

[*]Improved visualization of widgets
[*]Improved the visibility of the crosshair when the player hovers over an object that can be interacted with
[*]Improved reload sound sync with animation
[*]Changed loading screen
[/list]

[h1][b]FIXED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the light from the flashlight, which, after turning on the pause, could degrade the quality of the light itself
[*]Fixed fences, now you can shoot through them
[*]Fixed the limbs of demons that were twisting after death
[*]Fixed "YOU ARE HERE" pointer on wall maps
[*]Changed the position of the inscription "POWER", in sector A, so that the player does not experience difficulties in finding this room
[*]Fixed a light bulb near the computer in the sewer
[*]Fixed the initial splash screen where it was possible to turn on the inventory
[*]Fixed introductory text at low resolutions
[*]Fixed wall in sector A

[/list]

[h1][b]MINOR CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the position of the inscription "POWER", in sector A, so that the player does not experience difficulties in finding this room
[*]Increased the speed of the character on the stairs
[*]Removed the ability to lean
[*]Removed the ability to inspect items
[*]Changed saving in the dining room before the emergency opening of the gate
[/list]
